cuts.title: A conditional foundation for Lean for biology

scenes.narration: Could a biological design be checked as carefully as a program? MorphoSwarm Frontier is an early step toward Lean for biology: shared claims, equations, assumptions and evidence that people and agents can inspect.
scenes.headline: A question worth making inspectable

scenes.narration: We start with a demanding question: could a zebrafish acquire the structures needed to glide? Published fin-growth genetics supplies hypotheses, not a demonstrated route to flight.
scenes.headline: Published biology supplies hypotheses

scenes.narration: For a fin modeled as an elastic beam, we formalized a stiffness condition that bounds deflection. Lean compiled the theorem and rejected a corrupted law.
scenes.headline: A conditional beam bound, checked

scenes.narration: That checks a mathematical implication; whether the model describes a living fin still requires evidence. The studio connects bounded results across scales and exposes missing links as open questions.
scenes.headline: A proof does not establish its premises

scenes.narration: Through MCP, contributors can retrieve claims, submit work and contest evidence. Our goal is reusable, checkable biology: proof establishes what follows from a model; experiments establish when it applies.
scenes.headline: A shared, checkable scientific commons

cuts.title: From biological evidence to testable design

scenes.narration: Design a fish that can glide. That request spans genes, cell programs, growing tissues, fin mechanics and whole-animal behavior.
scenes.headline: A multiscale question

scenes.narration: Our approach is to make each connection inspectable. MorphoSwarm Frontier brings sourced claims, equations, assumptions and evidence into a shared workspace for people and agents. Published zebrafish studies connect transporter and ion-channel variants to altered fin proportions. They give us biological hypotheses, not a demonstrated route to flight.
scenes.headline: Claims, assumptions and evidence

scenes.narration: We also use measured specimen lengths to constrain candidate geometry.
scenes.headline: Measured lengths constrain geometry

scenes.narration: At the mechanical scale, consider a fin modeled as an end-loaded elastic beam. We formalized a stiffness condition that keeps deflection below one tenth of its length. Lean compiled the theorem; a corrupted law failed. The proof checks the implication. Measurements must establish whether the assumptions fit a real fin.
scenes.headline: A conditional mechanical result

scenes.narration: In the studio, you can inspect the equations, change design parameters and follow their evidence. We ran bending, aerodynamic, bioelectric and schooling models.
scenes.headline: Inspect the model chain

scenes.narration: Some exchange numerical outputs; genetic and developmental connections still need calibration. In a separate exploration, Evo2 generated sequence continuations. Model likelihood does not establish promoter function or cell-specific expression.
scenes.headline: A computational result has a boundary

scenes.narration: Validation is a first-class part of the design: check units and assumptions, test numerical resolution, compare with observations, and preserve failures. A failed flow benchmark remains failed. An independently identified print defect becomes a revision.
scenes.headline: Check, compare, preserve failures

scenes.narration: Every unresolved bridge becomes a question or proposed experiment. Through MCP, contributors can retrieve exact claims, submit artifacts and challenge results. This is an early foundation for Lean for biology: reusable knowledge that says what was checked, where it applies, and what evidence is needed next. The flying fish is one demanding test case for that larger scientific commons.
scenes.headline: Share evidence and open questions
